(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes, each diode being attached at specific locations on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body at intervals, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are arranged in a predetermined pattern around the columnar body.

(Currently Amended) Claim 6: The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are arranged at consistent intervals between said diodes.

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode is mounted on each face.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than about 100 W/ mK.

(Currently Amended) Claim 14: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current and providing necessary operational signals to the diodes.

(Currently Amended) Claim 15: The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element is configured to preferentially direct light in a manner that optimizes light distribution along an elongated axis of the columnar body.
